fact: The state digital operator's page says its cybersecurity actions follow the national cybersecurity strategy (SNC2022); the page carries no date, so the year is inferred from its 2022 footer and no strategy period is stated.

The Direction générale du chiffre et de la sécurité des systèmes d'information (DCSSI) is stated to co-organise the second cybersecurity providers forum and to set the course and norms for cybersecurity.

The Ministry of Communications, Telecommunications, Post and the Digital Economy's Senegalese National Cybersecurity Strategy (SNC2022), dated November 2017, sets five strategic aims to 2022 including a national cybersecurity structure with a CERT/CSIRT unit and a directory of critical information infrastructures; it states no adoption date, so as_of is its November 2017 imprint.
UNESCO's readiness profile lists a National Cybersecurity Strategy among Senegal's recent national strategies.
OSIRIS, citing Vie publique, reports Law No. 2026-20 on digital security, published in the Journal officiel, sets up a National Cybersecurity Authority.

OSIRIS, citing Vie publique, reports that Law No. 2026-20 on digital security, published in the Journal officiel, provides for identifying critical infrastructure in energy, health, telecommunications, financial services and administration, and binds its operators to notify cyber incidents within 24 hours.
